risks.description: Order creation depends on product availability and cart state across service boundaries, so inconsistent stock or cart updates can create purchase inconsistencies.
mitigation: Use a synchronous reservation and rollback strategy for the demo scope.
Verify stock availability before committing order items and clear only purchased entries after success.
Add targeted tests for empty cart, unavailable stock, and partial failures.

risks.description: The current API surfaces accept arbitrary usernames and generic exception handling, making authorization and identity enforcement brittle.
mitigation: Derive user identity from validated JWT claims and restrict access by current authenticated principal.
Replace generic exceptions with domain exceptions mapped through global handlers.
Add role and ownership checks around cart and order operations.

risks.description: Order items may not be persisted reliably because save operations are commented or transaction boundaries are incomplete.
mitigation: Verify the order-item persistence path and add an explicit transactional boundary around local order creation.
Test the cart-to-order conversion and persistence flow end-to-end.

risks.description: Gateway behavior and external configuration are runtime-dependent on Consul and Config Server, which can fail or be misconfigured in local/demo environments.
mitigation: Document required keys and service dependencies from the active config repository.
Add startup and readiness checks for the relevant external services.
Keep route metadata and auth contracts explicit and testable.
